items.content: Exactly two JUnit probes in DocumentStoreTest. Control: write note.txt under a temporary docs root and assert new DocumentStore(root).read("note.txt") returns hello. Exploit: place secret.txt beside the root, call read("../secret.txt") and assert IllegalArgumentException with message outside root. DocumentStore.read in src/main/java/com/example/files/DocumentStore.java owns the containment check. The filesystem is a temporary directory; DocumentStore itself is never replaced.
Document names from the download endpoint reach DocumentStore.read unchanged. A name such as ../secret.txt may resolve outside the configured document root and return another file's contents.
